findings.message: This only partly fixes the class. The surfaces list covers copy.ts, AREAS and the mock section. It does not cover the other copy that /welcome renders inline: Trust.tsx POINTS, Problem.tsx, ProductVideo.tsx figcaption, ChatPreview.tsx and Closing.tsx. A confirm claim added to any of them is never checked. Fix: check the HTML that WelcomePage actually renders (renderToStaticMarkup, then strip tags), or move those strings into copy.ts and add them to `surfaces`.
findings.scenario: Change Trust.tsx POINTS[2] to ["Role-scoped MCP", "Every MCP write waits for your confirm"] → marketing-confirm.test.ts stays green, and /welcome claims MCP writes are confirmed.

findings.message: The test only checks that the words "in chat" appear somewhere in the sentence. It doesn't check that the confirm is limited to chat. A sentence that names chat and also claims a confirm for MCP or for every write still passes. The reject table only tries claims with no "in chat" at all, so this case is never tested. Fix: also reject confirm sentences that match /\b(every|each|all)\b[^.]*\bwrites?\b|\bMCP\b/ in the same clause as the confirm. Add a reject case such as "In chat and over MCP, amax asks before it changes anything."
findings.scenario: Set STEPS[1].body to "In chat and over MCP, every write waits for a confirm." → the test passes, and the page claims MCP writes are confirmed.
